detail: Earliest inbound event selection must produce one target row per destination player-season.
All extra same-destination events are explicitly recorded as collapsed later events.
Small tolerance permits source minute conventions; independent verifier recomputes every row.
Adaptation target is an arithmetic difference, not a separate opaque score.
Scoring features remain physically separate from current-season outcomes.
Primary transfer matrices exclude scenario-only target-roster membership features.
Targets and predictors remain one-to-one on canonical_performance_id.
